title: Quantum Vacuum Catalyzation in Topological Excitonic Systems
description:
Preprint compilation of Quantum Vacuum Catalyzation (QVC) in topological excitonic vacuum crystals (TEVC), with working fat-torus geometry (r, R) = (8, 50) nm.

The deposit includes the September 2026 manuscript (TeX, figures, bibliography, supplements), frozen numerical parameters, Python verification and dynamics codes, crystal structures, and visualization suites. Vacuum fluctuations are treated as a catalyst, not an energy source.

Software under compute/ and sim/ is MIT. Manuscript, figures, locks, and documentation are CC BY 4.0.
